subject_v1: Tired of writing roofing bids at 9 PM?
body_v1:
Hey Austin Area Roofers team,

Most contractors I talk to around Austin, TX do the same thing: measure the job during the day, then spend 2 hours at their kitchen table at night writing estimates in Excel or on a notepad.

It kills your evenings and loses you jobs to guys who quote on the spot.

I built a dead-simple estimator for your phone and laptop (BuildCalc):
https://andrew4522-cr.github.io/buildcalc-pro/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=roofing

No $60/month subscriptions (Jobber/QuickBooks). No 40-minute onboarding setup. No login or credit card required.

If you like it, cool. If not, you still got a free estimate out of it.

Best,
BuildCalc Pro Team
